verdict.rationale: Notte documents live watching: sessions return a ViewerUrl you can open to watch the browser live, and the marketing site advertises "Live View & Replays" with screenshare and session playback. Nothing in the evidence shows a human taking interactive control mid-run when an agent stalls; the CDP/Playwright endpoint is a developer building block, not a takeover feature. missing for 10: documented human takeover/interactive control of a running agent session, a handoff-back-to-agent flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of live view.
